# DRank

> Ahrefs Domain Rating tracker feeding High Signal /domains and fleet domain marketing work.

## When to use this

DRank is best suited for:
- Looking up the current Ahrefs Domain Rating for a single domain via the free public endpoint.
- Browsing a weekly-refreshed public DR dataset for popular sites.
- Getting conservative, evidence-bounded DR advice from the AI advisor (no backlink or traffic data).

It is NOT a backlink analyzer, a paid Ahrefs metrics proxy, or a server-side personal-data store. Personal domain lists live in the visitor's browser only.

## Product

- [Home](https://domains.sassmaker.com/): Track Domain Rating history locally without an account
- [Public DR dataset](https://domains.sassmaker.com/data): Inspect and download weekly public Domain Rating observations
- [Changelog](https://domains.sassmaker.com/changelog): Verified DRank product and release history

## Machine surfaces

- [Agent catalog](https://domains.sassmaker.com/api/ai): JSON inventory of public surfaces
- [OpenAPI spec](https://domains.sassmaker.com/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 description of public agent surfaces
